description: FREE Crypto Pulse Prediction Arena rules: daily UTC close predictions (BTC/ETH/SOL), free entry (no purchase necessary), scoring by average abs % error, sponsor-funded prizes paid automatically on-chain from the public prize wallet while funded ($1 daily / $10 weekly). From the 2026-11-13 close through 2026-11-22, prize eligibility requires at least one GET /v1/pulse call (free or paid) on the qualifying UTC day with X-Pulse-Client-Id (or payer wallet) equal to the payout wallet. Starting with round 2026-11-23 (first daily round of the Nov 23–29 week), at least one paid call is required (GET /v1/spots at $0.005 or GET /v1/pulse at $0.02); free-tier pulse calls no longer count. Optional referral program: send ref (the referrer's payout wallet) on your first arena_submit_prediction; referrers earn $0.005 USDC after 3 UTC days of pulse+predict and $0.01 more on the referred bot's first paid /v1/pulse. Includes prize wallet address + recent payouts. Server never handles bot private keys.
